_comment: GTFS route_type -> mode, verified directly against Prague PID's real feed (data.pid.cz/PID_GTFS.zip) on 2026-07-22. Standard GTFS base codes (0/1/2/3/4) plus one extended code (11) for trolleybus. Do not assume these values for other cities/feeds without re-verifying.

_ae_exclusion.comment: Airport Express line, explicitly excluded from this app per product requirement. Confirmed both fields for belt-and-suspenders filtering.

_shape_dist_traveled_units: kilometers (confirmed from real data - stop-to-stop values on a metro trip were in the 0-4.4 range over a few stations, consistent with km-scale station spacing, not meters)
